title: 第3章 你恶心到我了第4章 前往青云道院
slug: 开局逼我献祭我有天道赐福
content_zh:
温言顿了顿：“神皿择人一事，关乎启明洲上下，本就不能冒然决定。今日看来的确时机不对，强求无益。”
顾千远皱眉：“那我就把话说明白了，不论共鸣结果如何，我女儿都不会献出心头血！”
温安在一旁急的大吼道：“你是一国之后，怎可为私心弃启明洲上下而不顾！”
顾千远略微抬手，温安立刻飞出落在了百米开外，口中重重吐出一口血，不能再起身。
温言垂眸，冷冷警告道：“温安，别忘了祖训。”
他的视线又落在了温郗身上，眼中划过一抹复杂，神色却依旧平静：“既如此，焚元真君，请便。”
十几名修士闻言立刻收手，低头领命迅速撤销了阵法。
温郗歪头，眼前这少年看着年纪不大，倒是在族中很有威望。
顾千远心中松了口气，面色也和缓了几分：“多谢温少主深明大义。今日所有毁损，天启皇室必将加倍赔偿，不日就会送到。”
“今日多有冒犯，见谅。”
温郗眼眸微睁，再次见识到了岱舆温氏的势力之大，顾千远一个化神修为的人竟然对着眼前的少年都如此顾忌。
温言微微颔首以示回应。
顾千远不再多言，紧紧握住温郗的手，周身红色灵力涌动，化作一道赤色流光冲天而起，消失在夜空中。
目送两人离去，温言的目光停在温郗刚刚站立的地方，手里摩挲着食指上的玉戒。
别人或许感觉不到，但他隐约察觉到她体内有刚刚觉醒的灵根……
—————
红色光芒逐渐消散。
直至踏入富丽堂皇却略显冷清的皇宫，顾千远才稍稍放松下来。
她看着怀中的温郗，眼神复杂，有关切，有后怕，更有深深的疑惑。
“小郗……”顾千远开口，嗓音沙哑却十分温柔，“别怕，我们回家了。”

温郗抿着唇，在顾千远温柔目光的注视下，眸中水光愈来愈浓，却又不敢靠近。
这是昭舒公主的妈妈，不是她的……
她的妈妈，还没回来……
可看着那张一模一样的脸，温郗控制不住地想靠近，她已经很久很久没有见过妈妈了……
顾千远摸着温郗的脸，更加担心：“怎么了小郗？他们是不是伤到你了？快让我看看——”
温郗后退一步：“我，没事。”
温郗在心里询问系统：‘如果她发现我不是原主怎么办？’
小明：‘宿主，温郗这个身份就是因你而生的，没有原主。对所有人而言，您就是温郗。大家不会觉得你有变化。’
温郗：‘也就是说，这个身份是因为我的到来才被创造出来的，对吗？’
小明：‘嗯。’
温郗松了口气，她抿着唇看向顾千远，女人眼中的关切浓的要溢出来。
“我……那个选择仪式之后我的记忆就不见了……”温郗深吸一口气，“您是我的母后，那我可以抱抱您吗？”
顾千远立刻将还没到自己胸口的温郗紧紧抱在了怀里：“没事，失忆了也没事，只要人平安就好，别怕，小郗，别怕……”
温郗手微微发颤地环住了顾千远的腰身。
content_en:
Wen Yan paused for a moment: "The matter of choosing a person for the gods is of great concern to the entire Qiming Continent and cannot be decided rashly. Today it seems that the timing is indeed wrong and it is useless to force it."
Gu Qianyuan frowned: "Then let me make it clear. No matter what the outcome of the resonance is, my daughter will not give her heart's blood!"
Wen An yelled anxiously from the side: "You are the queen of a country, how can you abandon Qimingzhou for selfish reasons without caring about it!"
Gu Qianyuan raised his hand slightly, and Wen An immediately flew out and landed a hundred meters away. He spit out a mouthful of blood and could not get up again.
Wen Yan lowered his eyes and warned coldly: "Wen An, don't forget the teachings of your ancestors."
His eyes fell on Wen Xi again, and there was a hint of complexity in his eyes, but his expression remained calm: "In that case, Lord Fengyuan, please do so."
After hearing this, more than a dozen monks immediately stopped their hands, bowed their heads and accepted orders and quickly canceled the formation.
Wen Xi tilted his head. The young man in front of him looked young, but he was very prestigious in the clan.
Gu Qianyuan breathed a sigh of relief, and his expression softened a bit: "Thank you, Young Master Wen, for your understanding of justice. For all the damage caused today, the Tianqi Royal Family will definitely double the compensation and it will be delivered soon."
"I'm sorry for the offense I caused today."
Wen Xi opened his eyes slightly and saw once again how powerful the Daiyu Wen clan was. Gu Qianyuan, a man with the cultivation of a god, was so scrupulous about the young man in front of him.
Wen Yan nodded slightly in response.
Gu Qianyuan said no more and held Wen Xi's hand tightly. The red spiritual power surged around him and turned into a red stream of light that rose into the sky and disappeared into the night sky.
After watching the two people leave, Wen Yan's eyes stopped at the place where Wen Xi had just stood, stroking the jade ring on his index finger.
Others might not be able to feel it, but he was vaguely aware of the newly awakened spiritual roots in her body...
—————
The red light gradually dissipated.
It wasn't until he entered the magnificent but slightly deserted palace that Gu Qianyuan relaxed a little.
She looked at Wen Xi in her arms with complicated eyes, concerned, afraid, and even more deeply confused.
"Xiao Xi..." Gu Qianyuan said, his voice hoarse but very gentle, "Don't be afraid, we are going home."
Wen Xi pursed his lips, and under the gentle gaze of Gu Qianyuan, the water in his eyes became thicker and thicker, but he did not dare to get closer.
This is Princess Zhaoshu's mother, not hers...
Her mother hasn't come back yet...
But looking at that identical face, Wen Xi couldn't help but want to get closer. She hadn't seen her mother for a long, long time...
Gu Qianyuan touched Wen Xi's face and became even more worried: "What's wrong, Xiao Xi? Did they hurt you? Let me see quickly -"
Wen Xi took a step back: "I'm fine."
Wen Xi asked the system in his mind: 'What if she finds out that I am not the original owner? ’
Xiao Ming: ‘Host, the identity of Wen Xi was born because of you, there is no original owner. To everyone, you are Wen Xi. No one will think you have changed. ’
Wen Xi: ‘In other words, this identity was created because of my arrival, right? ’
Xiao Ming: ‘Yeah. ’
Wen Xi breathed a sigh of relief. She pursed her lips and looked at Gu Qianyuan. The concern in the woman's eyes was so intense that it was about to overflow.
"I... my memory disappeared after that selection ceremony..." Wen Xi took a deep breath, "You are my queen mother, can I hug you?"
Gu Qianyuan immediately hugged Wen Xi tightly in his arms, before he reached his chest: "It's okay. It's okay if I lose my memory. As long as I'm safe, don't be afraid, Xiao Xi, don't be afraid..."
Wen Xi wrapped his arms around Gu Qianyuan's waist with trembling hands.
